description: This is a PHP acceptance test class for SuiteCRM, specifically testing user-related functionalities such as email account setup and subpanel hint visibility. It utilizes the Codeception testing framework with additional custom steps for interacting with the SuiteCRM interface.

classes.name: UsersCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for SuiteCRM User features, testing email account configuration and subpanel hint visibility.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method initializing fake data generator and seed before each test.

methods.name: testEmailSettingsMailAccountAdd
methods.description: Test case for adding and testing inbound email account settings in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testShowCollapsedSubpanelHint
methods.description: Test case for checking the visibility of collapsed subpanel hints and creating/deleting an account as part of the test flow.
